The chain rule for a multivariable function $f(x,y,z)$ with two independent variables $s$ and $t,$ where $x=x(s,t),y=y(s,t)$ and $z=z(s,t),$ can be expressed as follows:

$$
\frac{∂f}{∂s}=\frac{∂f}{∂x}\cdot \frac{∂x}{∂s}+\frac{∂f}{∂y}\cdot \frac{∂y}{∂s}+\frac{∂f}{∂z}\cdot \frac{∂z}{∂s}
$$

First, we find the partial derivatives of $f$ with respect to $x,y$ and $z:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x}=2,\,\frac{∂f}{∂y}=-1,\,\frac{∂f}{∂z}=3.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we take the derivatives of $x,$ $y,$ and $z$ with respect to $s,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂x}{∂s} & =-3, \\ \frac{∂y}{∂s} & =-2, \\ \frac{∂z}{∂s} & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting all of our derivatives into the multivariable chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂s} & =(2)\cdot (-3)+(-1)\cdot (-2)+(3)\cdot (-1) \\  & =-6 + 2 - 3 \\  & =-7.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["7b6b2a4f-ab9a-525f-a4e9-33f7a729e8b4"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "857a1876-c6e3-5505-9faa-9ecd990ae58a" :answer/id #uuid "857a1876-c6e3-5505-9faa-9ecd990ae58a" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-12" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c94708e4-84a0-5302-8628-b7126abcee55" :answer/id #uuid "c94708e4-84a0-5302-8628-b7126abcee55" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "0" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "d737bd49-5a89-5ae7-8f96-bf16b1e54625" :answer/id #uuid "d737bd49-5a89-5ae7-8f96-bf16b1e54625" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-9" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c3d56532-27b4-5eff-9836-0b6262145a88" :answer/id #uuid "c3d56532-27b4-5eff-9836-0b6262145a88" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-6" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fd34d9a4-823a-58a7-9e11-333648863951" :answer/id #uuid "fd34d9a4-823a-58a7-9e11-333648863951" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-3" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "935c08d8-4b0b-5756-9deb-58e791d8fbfd" :answer-field/id #uuid "935c08d8-4b0b-5756-9deb-58e791d8fbfd" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["857a1876-c6e3-5505-9faa-9ecd990ae58a" "c94708e4-84a0-5302-8628-b7126abcee55" "d737bd49-5a89-5ae7-8f96-bf16b1e54625" "c3d56532-27b4-5eff-9836-0b6262145a88" "fd34d9a4-823a-58a7-9e11-333648863951"] :answer-field/correct "c3d56532-27b4-5eff-9836-0b6262145a88" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "7c95ae4a-2914-518f-a79c-f9b0d943acd0" :question/id #uuid "7c95ae4a-2914-518f-a79c-f9b0d943acd0" :question/problem "Let $f(x,y,z)=(-3)\cdot (x)+(3)\cdot (y)+(3)\cdot (z),$ where $x=s + t$, $y=- t + 2 s$, $z=- 3 s + 2 t$.
